rules.description: Ensures every StatVar in each historical single-year partition (2012, 2014, 2018, 2021, 2022) has matching MinDate and MaxDate.

params.query: SELECT StatVar, MinDate, MaxDate FROM stats WHERE TRY_CAST(MinDate AS INTEGER) < 2024 OR TRY_CAST(MinDate AS INTEGER) IS NULL OR TRY_CAST(MaxDate AS INTEGER) IS NULL
params.condition: TRY_CAST(MinDate AS INTEGER) IN (2012, 2014, 2018, 2021, 2022) AND TRY_CAST(MaxDate AS INTEGER) = TRY_CAST(MinDate AS INTEGER)

rules.description: Enforces exact single-year date consistency on 2012..2022 and verifies 2024Onwards has >= 100 StatVars reaching the latest CRDC release within a 5-year lag window (allowing retired columns across future releases).

params.query: SELECT b.statvar_count, b.min_year, b.max_year, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stats s WHERE TRY_CAST(s.MaxDate AS INTEGER) = b.max_year) AS latest_year_statvar_count FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS statvar_count, MIN(TRY_CAST(MinDate AS INTEGER)) AS min_year, MAX(TRY_CAST(MaxDate AS INTEGER)) AS max_year FROM stats) b
params.condition: statvar_count >= 100 AND min_year IS NOT NULL AND max_year IS NOT NULL AND ((min_year IN (2012, 2014, 2018, 2021, 2022) AND max_year = min_year AND latest_year_statvar_count = statvar_count) OR (min_year = 2024 AND max_year >= YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) - 5 AND latest_year_statvar_count >= 100))
